scope: Diff-based PR-gate security review for release 0.4.6 candidate 3 (slop law) on feature/0.4.6 at head f50e6e9b2e7063ab8d450e6ca89178db34d43d8c. Surface: 2658c52d..f50e6e9b (merge-base with origin/develop; identical to a35cc486..f50e6e9b since develop's tree equals the merge-base), 33 commits, 150 files, +2960/-2043. Reviewed: core/fixed_sections.py, features/specs/{canon,doctor_memory,memory_canon,rules}.py, hooks/ctx_inject.py, features/spec_context/{service,scoped_law}.py, features/reports/retention.py, core/handoff_index.py, cli/_specs_resolution.py, features/chokepoints/pre_commit.py, container.py, core/model_registry.py, public assets (data/fixed/*, DADAIA.md, SLOP.md, personas, templates, deleted scaffold files), .gitattributes, .gitignore, CI hygiene script, poetry.lock, the deleted tests. Gates run at this head: denylist push gate (two shapes), pattern secrets scan (gitleaks not installed locally; CI secret-scan.yml covers the PR), pip-audit (locked delta + venv), dadaia public doctor, dadaia specs doctor, ruff format/check, mypy --strict, lint-imports, full pytest. VERDICT EVIDENCE: this record names f50e6e9b2e7063ab8d450e6ca89178db34d43d8c alone — it never transfers to a sha it did not examine. Two-hop rule: once committed on feature/0.4.6 this commit is the PR head, and features/chokepoints/verdict.py::covering_verdict accepts the head sha or the head's unique first parent. It is consumed once by the feature -> develop merge and deleted immediately after (DADAIA.md §4.2); a survivor is slop (§7.6). Any rework after this sha requires a new APPROVED verdict on the new sha.
verdict_reason: APPROVED at f50e6e9b2e7063ab8d450e6ca89178db34d43d8c. Zero CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM findings. The diff closes CVE-2026-76098 (mistune 3.3.2 -> 3.3.4, CVSS 7.5) with zero collateral lock movement; the deletion engine's lane guard, the scoped-law symlink refusal, the fixed-section id/path containment and the session-id self-identification were each verified from source and tests at the head; secrets/PII/denylist/public-privacy gates are clean; the full preflight and suite are green. Two LOW findings are non-blocking: an uncapped fixed-law body on the hook path (in-diff, same trust domain) and the CI Poetry 1.8.3 pin's advisories (outside the diff, mitigated by sha256 pins). Bug surface REDUCED (retention, spec_context, scoped_law, pre_commit each delete a path; nothing wraps an old one).

findings.message: F1 CWE-770 dadaia_workspace/hooks/ctx_inject.py:215-226 — _fixed_law_blocks appends the fixed-section body with no size cap; the sibling _digest_tech_stack caps at 24 lines (:185). Non-blocking, same trust domain.
findings.detail_md: The bound is indirect only: `specs doctor` FIXED-2 byte-equality, which never runs on the hook path. A consumer that edits the body between the markers bloats every session prompt until doctor runs. Fail-open holds (`main():355` broad except; OSError suppressed at `:220`); the regex has no nested quantifier.
findings.fix_recommendation: Apply the same line cap to each fixed body, or skip a body larger than the library fragment; keep the fail-open.

findings.message: F2 record-only, outside the diff — CI build tool poetry==1.8.3 (.github/workflows/ci.yml:82,116,143,169) carries PYSEC-2026-2260 (crafted wheel ../ arbitrary write, fix 2.3.3) and PYSEC-2026-2890 (sdist extraction traversal, fix 2.3.4); its dulwich 0.21.7 carries PYSEC-2026-2463/2466 (fix 1.2.5).
findings.detail_md: Not introduced by this PR. Exploitation needs a malicious artifact in the resolved set; `poetry.lock` pins sha256 for all 76 packages and the index is PyPI only, so a crafted wheel/sdist cannot enter unnoticed. The lock in this PR was regenerated by the same 1.8.3 (lock-version 2.1 -> 2.0), so the pin and the lock format now agree.
findings.fix_recommendation: Operational-change lane (constitution C-03): bump the CI Poetry pin to >= 2.3.4 and regenerate the lock once with that version (format returns to 2.1); pin the same Poetry on the dev machine.

findings.message: F3 venv-only advisories: pillow 12.2.0 (13 PYSEC ids, fix 12.3.0; via ImageHash/ImageIO/scikit-image), pip 24.0 (6 PYSEC ids) — absent from poetry.lock and pyproject; dm-capture-utils 0.1.0 skipped (not on PyPI).
findings.detail_md: `.dadaia/.venv` is the shared workspace venv; these packages belong to other tooling, not to this library's dependency set. `dm-capture-utils` is a consumer package installed by name — a same-name package appearing on PyPI would shadow it on a fresh install (dependency-confusion note for the consumer project, not this PR).
findings.fix_recommendation: Refresh the venv tooling at the operator's convenience; no action for this PR.

findings.message: F4 Positive: CVE-2026-76098 (mistune < 3.3.3, RecursionError DoS, CVSS 7.5) CLOSED — poetry.lock mistune 3.3.2 -> 3.3.4 in 70ba3a28; pip-audit on 3.3.4: no known vulnerabilities; venv installs 3.3.4.
findings.detail_md: Exposure surface was the panel's Markdown renderer (`features/panel/views/_md_render.py:28-31`, loopback-bound). Lock delta over the full range: 76 packages both sides; 0 added, 0 removed, 1 version moved (mistune); 0 hash drift on the 75 unchanged versions; `content-hash` unchanged (pyproject untouched). Header/lock-version moved 2.1 -> 2.0 because Poetry 1.8.3 regenerated it — the version CI pins.

findings.message: F5 Positive: features/reports/retention.py deletion engine lane guard verified — never leaves .dadaia/reports|handoff, never follows a symlink out, artifact.path traversal rejected, important protection covers node ref and members.
findings.detail_md: Reports via `rglob` (Python 3.12.3 does not descend into symlinked dirs) filtered by `_is_under(resolve)` (:187); handoffs via `scan_handoffs` filtered by `_is_under` (:215); `_artifact_to_report_path` rejects a non-`.dadaia/reports/` prefix, any `..` part and a resolve-escape (:262-271); `_normalize_to_artifact_ref` rejects absolute paths in both flavours and `..` (:243-246); `cleanup()` re-checks `_is_mutable_runtime_path` before every `unlink` (:112-116); `important` keyed by workspace ref (:203). A symlinked report/handoff pointing outside is read at most, never deleted. Tests: `tests/contract/test_reports_retention_cleanup.py:28-53, 56-82, 92-124`; `tests/contract/cli/test_cli_reports_retention.py:90-100`. Bug surface REDUCED: three loops -> one index, private handoff model and three timestamp parsers deleted (net -120 lines); `core/handoff_index.py::path_timestamp` is the one age rule.

findings.message: F6 Positive: features/spec_context/scoped_law.py:21,27-37 — O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_WRONLY|O_NOFOLLOW refuses a dangling and a live symlinked destination (errno 17, verified on this host), symlinked repo root and parent dir refused before the open; residual parent-dir TOCTOU (CWE-367) is same-trust-domain and unchanged.
findings.detail_md: Empirical check in the scratchpad: both symlink kinds refused with EEXIST, link target untouched, dangling target never created. Tests: `tests/unit/features/spec_context/test_scoped_law.py:62-84`; bridge templates pinned byte-exact to `@AGENTS.md\n` (:87-89). Two hand-written seams collapsed into one four-row table with one primitive.
findings.fix_recommendation: Optional hardening only: open the parent with O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW and create via dir_fd.

findings.message: F7 Positive: session-id spoofing surface bounded — cli/_specs_resolution.py:119-122 routes the CLI self-id through core.invocation.resolve_session_id (:145-169, sanitized [A-Za-z0-9_-]); pre_commit.py:108 deletes the 'pre-commit-anonymous' sentinel.
findings.detail_md: A forged `DADAIA_SESSION_ID`/harness id is compared only against presence-record filenames (`presence.py:222-224`), never used to build a path; the decision is always `allowed=True` (NO-LOCKS). The most a forged id achieves is silencing the advisory naming one colliding session, inside the committer's own environment. Bug surface reduced: the second identification path is gone.

findings.message: F8 Positive: fixed sections carry no user-controlled id or path — core/fixed_sections.py:13-31, memory_canon.py:48-68, doctor_memory.py:250-303 (relative_to raises on an outside path, atomic_write replaces a symlinked destination), canon.py:583-610; alive() folds over CANON via a container-injected callable (container.py:96-105), scaffold-image copy path deleted.
findings.detail_md: Section ids come only from the `FIXED_SECTIONS` table or the path-keyed lookup; `read_fixed_fragment` builds `<public>/data/fixed/<id>.md` from that id alone; markers are `re.escape`d. `lint-imports`: 7 contracts kept (features mutually independent; only cli._specs_resolution, container and hooks import core.invocation).

findings.message: F9 Positive: public asset hygiene (DADAIA §8.3) and secrets — zero hits over 2,960 added lines; denylist push gate exit 0 in both shapes; public doctor [ok] public-privacy; new fragments/SLOP.md/bridges/personas/skills carry no consumer name, hostname, IP, operator path or secret; three new BUGS.jsonl records redacted.

Local substitute: credential-shape, PEM, cloud/platform token, IPv4, hostname/ssh, `/home/`|`/Users/`, e-mail, eval/exec/shell=True/pickle/yaml.load, CDN and consumer-name patterns.
